move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Andreas Dralveck,

We have received your quotation and noted your interest in working with Hollerau. We offer a longer-term commitment for the full contract volume and reliable payment in exchange for a substantially lower price.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months, 8,400 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 28.70 per unit, 45 days net, 28 days lead time; option B: EUR 28.99 per unit, 90 days net, 28 days lead time; option C: EUR 28.80 per unit, 60 days net, 28 days lead time. Option A amounts to about EUR 241,080 over the term.
3. Basis: We have an offer at EUR 38.50 per unit (offer:70250-0).
4. Next step: We have put our invoice processing in order and will pay on the agreed due date. All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
